hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts quarterly cash-conversion-cycle contraction (DSO + DIO - DPO falling versus the comparable prior-year quarter), with at least one operating efficiency leg improving, no supplier-financing collapse, non-collapsing revenue/COGS/gross-profit context, and liquid SPY-relative leadership, may identify working-capital efficiency leaders before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

prediction.confidence_reason: Separate DSO, DIO, and DPO Companyfacts legs were directionally positive but failed old_thin, drawdown, or comparator gates. A combined cash-conversion-cycle contraction field is materially different because it requires collection or sell-through efficiency while avoiding supplier-financing deterioration, but sample and drawdown risk remain high.

A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC filed-date PIT revenue, COGS, receivables, payables, optional inventory, and gross-profit facts, the same cash-conversion-cycle contraction gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
